presets.name: C Major Sketchbook
presets.description: Keep melodic sketches in C major while preserving your rhythm.
presets.useCase: Improvise over a C major backing track or explore melodies on an unfamiliar controller.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — moves notes to the nearest pitch in C major.

presets.name: A Minor Nocturne
presets.description: Turn free playing into a melody in A natural minor.
presets.useCase: Write a reflective lead or find a topline over an A minor progression.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — moves notes into A natural minor.

presets.name: D Dorian Session
presets.description: Explore the minor colour and raised sixth of D Dorian.
presets.useCase: Jam over a D minor vamp with a brighter modal palette.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — fits pitches to D Dorian, including its characteristic B natural.

presets.name: Minimal Motion
presets.description: Short, scale-constrained notes for uncluttered melodic sketches.
presets.useCase: Keep a busy input part concise while trying ideas in C major.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — moves notes to the nearest pitch in C major.
Note Shortener — gives each note a 1/8 gate, synced to tempo.

presets.name: Classic Chord
presets.description: Play diatonic C major triads with one finger.
presets.useCase: Sketch chord progressions when you have a small keyboard or only one hand free.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — moves notes to the nearest pitch in C major.
Chordifier — builds 3-note major-key chords from each note.

presets.name: Minor Chord Diary
presets.description: Build A minor harmony from single notes.
presets.useCase: Find a minor-key accompaniment without entering every chord tone.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — moves notes into A natural minor.
Chordifier — builds 3-note minor-key chords from each note.

presets.name: Seventh Heaven
presets.description: Expand C major scale notes into four-note chords.
presets.useCase: Try richer seventh-chord colours for keys, pads or songwriting.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — moves notes to the nearest pitch in C major.
Chordifier — builds 4-note major-key chords from each note.

presets.name: Offbeat Chord Stabs
presets.description: Shift short C major chords an eighth note later.
presets.useCase: Play on the beat to create offbeat accompaniment against a steady pulse.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — moves notes to the nearest pitch in C major.
Chordifier — builds 3-note major-key chords from each note.
Note Delay — moves the whole phrase later by 1/8, synced to tempo.
Note Shortener — gives each note a 1/16 gate, synced to tempo.

presets.name: Chord Arpeggiator
presets.description: Turn single notes into ascending C major chord patterns.
presets.useCase: Create a moving synth accompaniment from a simple root-note performance.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — moves notes to the nearest pitch in C major.
Chordifier — builds 3-note major-key chords from each note.
Arpeggiator — plays chord tones in up order at 1/16 spacing across 1 octave.

presets.name: Falling Minor Arp
presets.description: Descending A minor chord tones at eighth-note spacing.
presets.useCase: Add a slower answering figure beneath a vocal or lead.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — moves notes into A natural minor.
Chordifier — builds 3-note minor-key chords from each note.
Arpeggiator — plays chord tones in down order at 1/8 spacing across 1 octave.

presets.name: Two Octave Pendulum
presets.description: Sweep C major chords up and down across two octaves.
presets.useCase: Give a sparse progression a wider register and a repeating contour.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — moves notes to the nearest pitch in C major.
Chordifier — builds 3-note major-key chords from each note.
Arpeggiator — plays chord tones in up-down order at 1/16 spacing across 2 octaves.

presets.name: Triplet Cascade
presets.description: Spread major chord tones into ascending triplets.
presets.useCase: Try a rolling three-part subdivision against a straight beat.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — moves notes to the nearest pitch in C major.
Chordifier — builds 3-note major-key chords from each note.
Arpeggiator — plays chord tones in up order at triplet spacing across 2 octaves.

presets.name: Staccato Arp
presets.description: Crisp ascending chord patterns with short gates.
presets.useCase: Leave space between synth notes so a dense arrangement stays clear.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — moves notes to the nearest pitch in C major.
Chordifier — builds 3-note major-key chords from each note.
Arpeggiator — plays chord tones in up order at 1/8 spacing across 1 octave.
Note Shortener — gives each note a 1/16 gate, synced to tempo.

presets.name: Shuffled Chord Tones
presets.description: Reorder C major chord tones randomly while staying in harmony.
presets.useCase: Discover melodic variations without scattering pitches outside the chord.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — moves notes to the nearest pitch in C major.
Chordifier — builds 3-note major-key chords from each note.
Arpeggiator — plays chord tones in random order at 1/8 spacing across 1 octave.

presets.name: Double Tap
presets.description: Two short strikes for every note you play.
presets.useCase: Add a double hit to a pluck or percussion patch; 125 ms spacing suits sixteenths at 120 BPM.

steps.summary: Note Repeater — plays 2 strikes per note, 125 ms apart, each lasting 50 ms. Spacing stays fixed when tempo changes.

presets.name: Chord Repeater
presets.description: Turn a root note into four evenly spaced C major chord strikes.
presets.useCase: Build a rhythmic chord pulse; 250 ms spacing suits eighth notes at 120 BPM.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — moves notes to the nearest pitch in C major.
Chordifier — builds 3-note major-key chords from each note.
Note Repeater — plays 4 strikes per note, 250 ms apart, each lasting 100 ms. Spacing stays fixed when tempo changes.

presets.name: Ratchet Fill
presets.description: Eight rapid, short strikes from one input note.
presets.useCase: Trigger a brief roll for transitions or fills; 62.5 ms spacing suits thirty-seconds at 120 BPM.

steps.summary: Note Repeater — plays 8 strikes per note, 62.5 ms apart, each lasting 50 ms. Spacing stays fixed when tempo changes.

presets.name: Late Answer
presets.description: Move your phrase a quarter note behind your playing.
presets.useCase: Create a delayed response on a separate chain alongside a direct part.

steps.summary: Note Delay — moves the whole phrase later by 1/4, synced to tempo.

presets.name: Bass Register
presets.description: Move a C major melody down one octave.
presets.useCase: Reuse a midrange keyboard part as a bass line with a bass instrument on this chain.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — moves notes to the nearest pitch in C major.
Transposer — shifts every note down 12 semitones.

presets.name: Upper Octave Sparkle
presets.description: Raise C major notes an octave and give them short gates.
presets.useCase: Add a high pluck layer on a separate chain above your main performance.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — moves notes to the nearest pitch in C major.
Transposer — shifts every note up 12 semitones.
Note Shortener — gives each note a 1/8 gate, synced to tempo.

presets.name: Fifth Above
presets.description: Transpose your performance up a perfect fifth.
presets.useCase: Layer this chain with a direct chain for a parallel fifth, or move a part into another key.

steps.summary: Transposer — shifts every note up 7 semitones.

presets.name: Low Minor Pulse
presets.description: Short A minor notes shifted an octave down.
presets.useCase: Sketch a detached bass part beneath a minor-key arrangement.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — moves notes into A natural minor.
Transposer — shifts every note down 12 semitones.
Note Shortener — gives each note a 1/8 gate, synced to tempo.

presets.name: Acid House
presets.description: Short A minor bass arpeggios at sixteenth-note spacing.
presets.useCase: Play single notes around A3 to generate low minor figures. Try 120–130 BPM with a resonant mono synth; vary accents and filter cutoff on your instrument.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — keeps notes in A natural minor.
Chordifier — builds 3-note diatonic chords.
Transposer — shifts notes down one octave.
Arpeggiator — plays chord tones up at 1/16 spacing, synced to tempo.
Note Shortener — gives notes a 1/32 gate, synced to tempo.

presets.name: Techno Pulse
presets.description: Clipped, low A minor notes for a driving bass motif.
presets.useCase: Play a repeating sixteenth-note rhythm around A3 over a four-on-the-floor kick. Adjust tempo and synth tone to suit your track.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — keeps notes in A natural minor.
Transposer — shifts notes down one octave.
Note Shortener — gives notes a 1/32 gate, synced to tempo.

presets.name: Dub Stabs
presets.description: Short minor chords shifted onto the offbeat.
presets.useCase: Play on quarter-note beats to place minor chord stabs an eighth note later. Add delay and reverb on your instrument for space.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — keeps notes in A natural minor.
Chordifier — builds 3-note diatonic chords.
Note Delay — shifts the phrase later by 1/8, synced to tempo.
Note Shortener — gives notes a 1/16 gate, synced to tempo.

presets.name: Disco Keys
presets.description: Bright C major seventh chords with a short rhythmic gate.
presets.useCase: Play syncopated single notes to sketch disco keys over a bass groove. Use a piano or electric piano patch.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — keeps notes in C major.
Chordifier — builds 4-note diatonic chords.
Note Shortener — gives notes a 1/8 gate, synced to tempo.

presets.name: Ambient Drift
presets.description: Slow descending A minor chord tones for spacious sketches.
presets.useCase: Play sparse single notes into a pad with a long release and reverb. Lower the tempo to spread the quarter-note arpeggio.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — keeps notes in A natural minor.
Chordifier — builds 4-note diatonic chords.
Arpeggiator — plays chord tones down at 1/4 spacing, synced to tempo.

presets.name: Gentle Strummed Chords
presets.description: Turn one-finger chords into soft alternating strokes.
presets.useCase: Play single notes to sketch a strummed accompaniment.

steps.summary: Build diatonic triads.
Keep dynamics gentle.
Alternate up and down strokes.

presets.name: Smooth Chord Voices
presets.description: Keep chord changes in a comfortable register with less voice movement.
presets.useCase: Play chords or single-note chord roots.

steps.summary: Generate chords in C major.
Choose nearby chord voicings.

presets.name: Held Euclidean Pulses
presets.description: Latch a chord and turn it into a rotating five-in-sixteen pulse.
presets.useCase: Play a chord, release the keys and use Latch Enabled to stop.

steps.summary: Hold the last chord.
Five pulses over sixteen steps.

presets.name: Sparse Drum Variation
presets.description: Thin a drum pattern with repeatable chance and varied dynamics.
presets.useCase: Feed a busy drum pattern into this chain.

steps.summary: Keep about 70% of incoming hits.
Vary the strength of surviving hits.

presets.name: Breathing Mod Wheel
presets.description: Send a smooth four-beat modulation cycle while notes are held.
presets.useCase: Use an instrument that responds to MIDI CC 1.

steps.summary: Animate the modulation wheel.

presets.name: Mod Wheel to Expression
presets.description: Map the modulation wheel to a useful expression range.
presets.useCase: Control MIDI CC 11 with a hardware modulation wheel.

steps.summary: Map CC 1 to CC 11.

presets.name: Connected Ornaments
presets.description: Join a melody smoothly and add light upper-note mordents.
presets.useCase: Play a monophonic line; the final note ends after four beats.

steps.summary: Join successive notes.
Decorate selected notes.

presets.name: Rotating Phrase
presets.description: Capture four beats and replay the rhythm with rotated pitches.
presets.useCase: Play a short phrase, then listen; playing again records a fresh phrase.

steps.summary: Rotate the captured pitches by one note.

presets.name: Drum Map: Octave Layer
presets.description: Map selected drum notes and layer the snare an octave above.
presets.useCase: Try a drum controller or edit the map for your instrument.

steps.summary: Layer snare note 38 with note 50.

presets.name: Mirrored Melody
presets.description: Turn rising phrases into falling phrases around middle C.
presets.useCase: Explore an inverted melodic idea, then adjust the mirror centre.

steps.summary: Mirror intervals around MIDI note 60.

presets.name: Parallel Fifths
presets.description: Add a perfect fifth and octave to each note.
presets.useCase: Build open power-chord textures from a single melodic line.

steps.summary: Stack a root, fifth and octave.

presets.name: Falling Note Bounces
presets.description: Create accelerating repeats that become softer with each bounce.
presets.useCase: Hold a note to hear the complete bounce pattern.

steps.summary: Play up to eight progressively shorter bounces.

presets.name: Release Octaves
presets.description: Add a short octave response whenever a key is released.
presets.useCase: Play short phrases and let the release notes answer them.

steps.summary: Keep the attack and add a softer octave on release.

presets.name: Mono High Priority
presets.description: Keep only the highest held note when notes overlap.
presets.useCase: Extract a top line from chords or protect a monophonic instrument.

steps.summary: Discard the lowest note when the voice limit is reached.

presets.name: Keyboard Channel Split
presets.description: Send the left and right sides of the keyboard to different MIDI channels.
presets.useCase: Use a multitimbral instrument listening on channels 1 and 2.

steps.summary: Route notes below middle C to channel 1 and the rest to channel 2.

presets.name: Four Channel Voices
presets.description: Distribute successive notes across four independent MIDI channels.
presets.useCase: Connect synth voices or multitimbral parts on channels 2 through 5.

steps.summary: Assign one note per channel and steal the oldest when full.

presets.name: Stepped Mod Wheel
presets.description: Turn the modulation wheel into eight rhythmic steps.
presets.useCase: Use a synth that responds to CC 1, then move the wheel between beats.

steps.summary: Quantise CC 1 to eight values on a sixteenth-note grid.

presets.name: Slow Chord Bloom
presets.description: Let each held note gradually grow a fifth, octave and upper fifth.
presets.useCase: Hold single notes or sparse chords to create a sustained harmonic texture.

steps.summary: Add a new sustained voice every beat; release to end the bloom.

presets.name: Two-Note Shadow
presets.description: Let the pitch from two attacks earlier answer in a lower octave to your current rhythm.
presets.useCase: Play a monophonic melody and vary the timing to reshape its shadow.

steps.summary: Add a softer shadow from two attacks back.

presets.name: Expressive Contour
presets.description: Lift rising lines, soften falling lines and emphasise melodic leaps.
presets.useCase: Use a controller with fixed or limited velocity to add expression from pitch direction.

steps.summary: Scale velocity from melodic direction and interval size.

presets.name: Three-Five Weave
presets.description: Weave an every-third-gesture strand with an every-fifth-gesture strand.
presets.useCase: Play a steady sequence of notes or chords; both strands meet every fifteen gestures.

steps.summary: Play either strand and accent their meetings.

presets.name: Orbiting Pitch Classes
presets.description: Keep the pitch classes of your playing while their octaves move through a register.
presets.useCase: Repeat a short idea and listen to its register evolve.

steps.summary: Move the octave target by seven semitones per gesture, wrapping within the register.
